entries.title: Mifflin-St Jeor resting energy expenditure equation
entries.method: REE prediction from sex, age, height and body mass
entries.source: Mifflin MD et al. A new predictive equation for resting energy expenditure in healthy individuals.
entries.limitations: Population equation; individual measured expenditure can differ materially.

entries.title: ISSN position stand: protein and exercise
entries.method: Protein intake ranges for healthy exercising adults
entries.source: Jäger R et al. International Society of Sports Nutrition Position Stand: protein and exercise.
entries.limitations: General ranges require individual context; not a prescription for kidney disease or other clinical conditions.

entries.title: Protein supplementation and resistance-training adaptations
entries.method: Meta-analysis/meta-regression of protein supplementation with resistance training
entries.limitations: Group-level response; does not establish a precise optimum for every individual.

entries.title: Protein during caloric restriction in resistance-trained lean athletes
entries.journal: International Journal of Sport Nutrition and Exercise Metabolism
entries.limitations: Small evidence base and athlete-specific population; higher ranges are not automatically appropriate for all users.

entries.title: Age-predicted maximal heart rate
entries.source: Tanaka H, Monahan KD, Seals DR. Age-predicted maximal heart rate revisited.
entries.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
entries.limitations: Population estimate with substantial individual error; measured HRmax is preferable when valid and safe.

entries.title: Riegel race-time prediction
entries.source: Riegel PS. Athletic records and human endurance.
entries.limitations: Approximation derived from performance records; accuracy depends on distance, training specificity and endurance profile.

entries.title: Rockport one-mile walk VO2max estimate
entries.method: Validated field equation using walk time, HR, age, sex and body mass
entries.source: Kline GM et al. Estimation of VO2max from a one-mile track walk, gender, age, and body weight.
entries.limitations: Population-dependent estimate; subsequent studies have reported bias in some groups.

entries.title: Cooper 12-minute field test
entries.method: Distance-based field estimate of aerobic fitness
entries.source: Cooper KH. A means of assessing maximal oxygen intake.
entries.limitations: Indirect estimate; performance, pacing and population affect error.

entries.title: 2024 Compendium of Physical Activities
entries.method: Standard MET values for physical activities
entries.source: Herrmann SD et al. 2024 Adult Compendium of Physical Activities.
entries.limitations: Standard METs are population reference values and do not precisely measure an individual's energy expenditure.
